component.name: Retro Multi Tools
component.summary: Manage, inspect, and patch retro game ROMs

description.p: Retro Multi Tools is a cross-platform desktop utility for managing, inspecting, and patching retro game ROMs. It supports 46 console and computer systems and provides a comprehensive set of tools for ROM management, verification, conversion, and emulation.

ul.li: ROM Browser with Big Picture Mode — fullscreen, controller-friendly ROM library with box art, favorites, and play statistics
ROM Inspector — detect system type, parse headers, and fetch artwork from the Libretro Thumbnails database
ROM Patcher — apply IPS, BPS, and xDelta/VCDIFF patches with full validation
Verification tools — checksum calculator, DAT verifier (No-Intro and TOSEC), dump verifier, duplicate finder, and batch ROM hasher
Conversion tools — N64 format converter, ROM format converter, save file converter, and archive manager
Cheat code converter — decode and encode Game Genie, Pro Action Replay, GameShark, and other cheat formats for 15+ systems
MAME integration — ROM set auditor, CHD verifier and converter, DAT editor, ROM set rebuilder, and Dir2Dat creator
RetroArch integration — playlist creator, shortcut creator, core downloader, and RetroAchievements writer
Disc tools — burn disc images, create ISOs from discs or folders
USB tools — format drives, write disk images, create backups
Analogue device support — Pocket, Mega SG, NT, and Super NT
